title: Faction deed (reads "<Faction> <deed>") — the trouble a faction stirs up

entries.value: have carried off a merchant's heir for ransom
put the outlying farms to the torch
waylaid the tithe-wagons on the road
dragged three villagers into the dark
sacked a waystation and left no survivors
have been exacting a blood-tribute from the hamlets
seized a noble's envoy and her whole retinue
burned a wayside shrine and scattered its keepers
press-ganged the young folk of a border village
looted a pilgrim caravan bound for the shrine
have grown bold, raiding now by daylight
butchered a merchant train to the last mule
hold the river ford and bleed all who cross
spirited a village's children away in the night
